title: Natthi puttasamam
text: Ekam antaṃ ṭhitā kho sā devatā Bhagavato santike imaṃ gātham abhāsi. || || Natthi puttasamaṃ pemaṃ || natthi gosamitam dhanaṃ || natthi suriyasamā ābhā. || samudda paramā sarāti || || Natthi attasamaṃ pemaṃ || natthi dhaññasamaṃ dhanaṃ || natthi paññāsamā ābhā || vuṭṭhi ve paramā sarā ti || ||
